header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Ajay Kumar advocate for the appellant.
Through this Criminal Acquittal Appeal, the appellant has
challenged judgment dated 14-06-2017 passed by learned 1
Additional Sessions Judge, Sanghar, in Sessions Case No.184 of
2015, arising out of Complaint under sections 03 and 04 of Illegal
Dispossession Act, 2005 filed by the appellant. Learned counsel for
body: the appellant was put on notice to satisfy the Court about maintainability of this Acquittal Appeal in absence of application for Special Leave to Appeal as required under section 417(2) Cr.P.C; he submits that same was not filed; however, requested that he is ready to file said application by today. Perusal of impugned judgment reflects that it was passed in year 2017 and by virtue of section 417(3) Cr.P.C only 60 days’ time is allowed for filing such application. In such circumstances even if said application is allowed to be filed, it would be time barred and, therefore, cannot be entertained.
In view of above situation, the Criminal Acquittal Appeal being non-maintainable is hereby dismissed.
